subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: Which agent harnesses, if any, should survive an activated empty plugin scope during loader and gateway reloads?
rationale: Current main clears all plugin runtime state for empty scopes, while the open candidate PR would restore every prior harness; the right contract affects plugin disablement, provider routing, and security boundaries.

options.title: Preserve approved always-on harnesses only
options.body: Define an ownership-aware rule that keeps bundled or always-on provider harnesses available while still clearing disabled or unscoped plugin-owned harnesses.

options.title: Keep empty scopes fully empty
options.body: Retain the current fail-closed behavior and solve the user-visible race with readiness gating, retry, or earlier activation without preserving harnesses.

options.title: Accept restore-all semantics
options.body: Allow all prior harnesses to survive empty-scope reloads and document that behavior as intentional despite plugin disablement risk.

recommendation.title: Preserve approved always-on harnesses only
recommendation.body: Define an ownership-aware rule that keeps bundled or always-on provider harnesses available while still clearing disabled or unscoped plugin-owned harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the harness registry and is the strongest history-backed owner for the core runtime contract.
